title: Yes-path §5.4 confirmation line: handler wiring of reference_contact_attested flag has no test (PARTIAL, P1)
evidence:
reference_contact_attested: get_form_value(
      values,
      reference_attestation.field_name,
    )
      == reference_attestation.attested_value,
--- and the only attested-path integration test (gdpr_integration_test.gleam:2514) ---
    |> application_handler.handle_post_form(test_server_config(db), short_code)
  resp.status |> should.equal(200)

  let app_id = fetch_application_id_by_email(db, email)
detail: view_confirmation_page is unit-tested both flag ways, but the finalise_application derivation is the untested hop: the attested/declined POST integration tests assert status and DB rows, never the response body. Flipping the comparison to declined_value passes every test.
recommended_fix: In apply_submission_attested_writes_reference_attestation_test assert simulate.read_body(resp) contains "ref-attestation-confirmation"; assert its absence in apply_submission_declined_writes_no_attestation_test.

title: Error-state aria-describedby join (help + error id) has no assertion
detail: The error branch (error span id joins aria-describedby, added per the spec's own review amendment) is unpinned: card_error_state_shows_message_and_has_error_test checks only has-error, the message, and role="alert". Dropping the join passes all tests.
recommended_fix: In card_error_state_shows_message_and_has_error_test assert aria-describedby="ref-attestation-help field-reference_contact_choice-error" and id="field-reference_contact_choice-error" are present.

title: Vacuous "required" assertion — satisfied by aria-required even if the radio required attribute is dropped
evidence:
// Required, and the error-summary anchor id on the card.
  html |> string.contains("required") |> should.be_true
--- card source already renders ---
          attribute("aria-required", "true"),
detail: "aria-required=\"true\"" contains the substring "required", so this assertion passes even with attribute("required", "") removed from both radios; the AC's "radio pair is required" HTML attribute is effectively unpinned.
recommended_fix: Assert the rendered bare-attribute form, e.g. string.contains("required type=\"radio\"") (attributes render name-sorted), or assert exactly two bare required occurrences.
